name: eX=psY-R (Ecstacy Returns)

source:
Haruki came back!
One morning, Haruki wakes up and realizes that he has become a girl!

This is the first episode of the remake of the circle's first work.

Is it confusing to gradually become a girl? Or actually it is a pleasure?
He says "No way!"
